notes:
I couldn't write these notes. My research tools stopped working before I could read any sources. My first set of searches went over the tool's usage limit and returned nothing. When I tried one more search, the tool said I had no calls left for this turn. That means I haven't opened a single page from the approved sites.

You asked me to report only what the pages actually say and to give a URL for every point. Notes written now would have to come from my own memory with no sources behind them, so I've left them out.

**What I'll do when the tools work again.** I'll keep the number of searches small and fetch the main sources directly:
- **Verse-by-verse (traditional reading):** Enduring Word's Obadiah commentary; Bible Hub's Obadiah 1 pages for Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary; the Precept Austin Obadiah pages.
- **Protestant differences:** sources such as Spurgeon, Desiring God, The Gospel Coalition, Ligonier, Wesley Center (Wesley's notes), Seedbed and LCMS/1517. I'd look especially at vv. 17–21, on whether the promises to "Jacob" and "Zion" mean ethnic Israel or the church, and vv. 15–16 on the Day of the LORD.
- **Other views:** NET Bible notes on hard words (Teman, Sepharad, Zarephath, the "drinking" in v. 16, and the date in vv. 11–14); Bible Odyssey on Edom and on dating; the Catholic Encyclopedia article "Abdias" on newadvent.org; Catholic.com and OCA pages if they cover Obadiah.

If you'd like, ask again in a new message and I'll start with those direct fetches. Or you can paste in the text of any of these pages, and I'll write verse-by-verse notes from them with URLs.
